title: Collecting money through Scoryboard - an overview
description: Ask your players for money, track who has paid, and pay what you owe. Here is how the whole thing fits together.
body:
Scoryboard lets you ask your players for money and pay them back. Everything lives under Payment in the sidebar.

Before you start

To ask for money you need a payout account. Setting one up takes a few minutes and you only do it once. See "Setting up your payout account".

To pay a request you need nothing. Anybody can pay.

How it works

  1. Open Payment. Before you have asked for anything, the page shows you the three steps.

  2. Choose Request Payment and pick where your players come from. You can charge a leaderboard, a team or your friends list.

  3. REQUESTED lists everything you have asked for, and how many people have paid.

  4. PAY lists what you owe other people.

  5. Payments also sit on a team, a leaderboard and a match, under their own PAYMENT tab.

What you will see

Money is handled by Stripe, not by Scoryboard. Your bank details go to Stripe and Scoryboard never sees them.

Every amount is in pounds. Each request carries a small transaction fee, and you choose whether your players pay it or you do. See "Fees - passing them on or absorbing them".
